findings.text: S-3 AC4 covers 'every part' of the page for 'any patient' without naming the parts or a baseline, so a tester has no bounded list to check. It restates REQ-9 rather than making it checkable.

findings.suggested_fix: In S-3 AC2, give the patient past Completed, No-show and Cancelled appointments and state that all of them still appear in the same order.
findings.text: The appointments-list regression ACs use only Scheduled and Completed rows or unspecified past rows. A list wrongly filtered to drop Cancelled or No-show rows would still pass both.

rubric_items.reason: All nine known REQs are traced: S-1 covers REQ-1, 2, 3, 6; S-2 covers REQ-4, 5; S-3 covers REQ-7, 8, 9. The intent has no assumed or unknown items.
Three stories, each one user-visible outcome (see the counts, what is excluded, nothing else changes). None exceeds five criteria.

All ACs are Given/When/Then and most discriminate well (distinct counts, Cancelled most recent, past Scheduled not closed, other patient, old date). S-3 AC4 is unbounded, and the list regression ACs omit Cancelled and No-show rows.
Statuses, All time, 0 for each and the Period options come from the intent or glossary. Counts and the 2 January 2025 date are concrete scenario values, with the reason stated inline.
Clear, consistent glossary terms (Completed, No-show, Scheduled, Cancelled, Visit summary). Body sections mirror the front matter with the same ids.
